<div class="container body-content">
        




    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <title>Unified Checkout Integration</title>
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jwt-decode@3.1.2/build/jwt-decode.min.js"></script>

    <script>
        function loadAcceptJs(clientLibrary, clientLibraryIntegrity,callback) {
            const s = document.createElement("script");
            s.src = clientLibrary;
            s.integrity = clientLibraryIntegrity;
            s.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
            s.onload = callback;
            s.onerror = () => console.error("Failed to load Accept.js library");
            document.head.appendChild(s);
        }

        async function launchCheckout() {
            try {
                const callBackUrl = document.getElementById("paymentCallBackUrl").value;
                const captureContext = document.getElementById("captureContext").value;
			   const requestRefNumber = document.getElementById("requestrefnumber").value;
                const sidebar = false;

                const showArgs = {
                    containers: {
                        paymentSelection: "#buttonPaymentListContainer",
                        paymentScreen: sidebar ? undefined : "#embeddedPaymentContainer"
                    }
                };

                const accept = await Accept(captureContext);
                const up = await accept.unifiedPayments(sidebar);
                const tt = await up.show(showArgs);

                const transientTokenElement = document.getElementById('ReceivedTransientToken');
                 const loaderElement = document.getElementById('LoaderTransientToken');

                if (loaderElement) {
                    loaderElement.style.display = "none";
                }

                if (transientTokenElement) {
                    transientTokenElement.value = tt;
                    transientTokenElement.style.display = "block";
                }

                const completeResponse = await up.complete(tt);
                console.log("completeResponse" + completeResponse);
                const decodedPayload = jwt_decode(completeResponse);
                console.log("decodedPayload" + decodedPayload);
                displayResponse(decodedPayload);
		    // ===== STATUS HANDLING START =====
                const status =
                decodedPayload.status ||
                decodedPayload.outcome ||
                decodedPayload.details?.status ||
                decodedPayload.details?.reason ||
                "UNKNOWN";

                console.log("Payment Status:", status);



// Server callback URL
const redirecturl =
    callBackUrl
    + '?status=' + encodeURIComponent(status)
    + '&requestRef=' + encodeURIComponent(requestRefNumber)
    + '&decodeJson=' + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(decodedPayload));

// Handle status
if (status === "PENDING_AUTHENTICATION") {
    console.log("Authentication required.");
    window.location.href = redirecturl;
}
else if (status === "AUTHORIZED" || status === "SUCCESS") {
    console.log("Payment Authorized / Successful.");
    window.location.href = redirecturl;
}
else if (status === "DECLINED") {
    console.log("Payment DECLINED.");
    window.location.href = redirecturl;
}
else if (status === "FAILED") {
    console.log("Payment Failed.");
    window.location.href = redirecturl;
}
else if (status === "INVALID_REQUEST" || status === "INVALID_DATA") {
    console.log("Invalid request/data.");
    window.location.href = redirecturl;
}
else {
    console.log("Unknown status:", status);
    window.location.href = redirecturl;
}
// ===== STATUS HANDLING END =====

            } catch (error) {
                console.error("Something went wrong: " + error);
            }
        }

        function displayResponse(response) {
            const respEl = document.getElementById('responseDisplay');
    if(respEl){
        respEl.value = JSON.stringify(response, null, 2);
    }
        }

        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
            const clientLibrary = document.getElementById("clientLibrary").value;
            const clientLibraryIntegrity = document.getElementById("clientLibraryIntegrity").value;
            console.log("Client library:", clientLibrary);
            console.log("Client library integrity available:", !!clientLibraryIntegrity);

            loadAcceptJs(
                clientLibrary,
                clientLibraryIntegrity,
                function () {

                    console.log(
                        "Accept.js loaded successfully."
                    );

                    launchCheckout();
                }
            );

        });
    </script>
